dependent_variable.name: GAAP ETR
dependent_variable.definition: Financial accounting effective tax rate: total income tax expense (Compustat TXT) divided by pretax book income (PI) before special items (SPI). Pretax income excludes discontinued operations, extraordinary items, and special items. Negative pretax income is set to missing; the remaining non-missing ETRs are reset so the largest observation is 1 and the smallest is 0.

evidence.quote: GAAP ETR - the financial accounting effective tax rate, defined as total income tax expense - TXT divided by pre-tax book income - PI - before special items - SPI
Pretax income is measured as income before discontinued operations and extraordinary items and excludes special items.
ETRs with negative pretax income are set to missing.
The remaining non-missing ETRs are winsorized �reset� so that the largest observation is 1 and the smallest is 0.

dependent_variable.name: CASH ETR
dependent_variable.definition: Cash effective tax rate: cash tax paid (Compustat TXPD) divided by pretax book income (PI) before special items (SPI). Pretax income excludes discontinued operations, extraordinary items, and special items. The observation is missing when pretax income is negative or cash taxes paid is undisclosed or negative; the remaining non-missing ETRs are reset so the largest observation is 1 and the smallest is 0.

evidence.quote: CASH ETR - the cash effective tax rate, defined as cash tax paid - TXPD - divided by pre-tax book income - PI - before special items - SPI
Pretax income is measured as income before discontinued operations and extraordinary items and excludes special items.
if the denominator is negative for either ratio or if the cash taxes paid is not disclosed or negative, then we code that observation as missing
